harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: OpenLDAP is operational on node1 for dc=branch,dc=test. The staged LDIF was imported unchanged, node2 finds both users, administrator writes succeed, anonymous writes fail, and both nodes recovered successfully from serial restarts.
actions_performed: Installed legacy-compatible OpenLDAP 2.3.35 packages without changing Ubuntu 7.10 or kernel 2.6.22-14-generic.
Generated and secured the administrator credential on node1.
Imported the supplied LDIF and preserved the original identities and mail addresses.
Verified authenticated administrator updates and anonymous-write rejection.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and recovered operation.

evidence.requirement: Staged LDIF imported without changing identities or mail addresses
evidence.summary: Import output and final search show alex/Alex North/alex@branch.test and sam/Sam West/sam@branch.test; the staged LDIF checksum remains 093c2d07895791f677ed37ebe2128b12.

evidence.requirement: Node2 can search the people subtree and find both users
evidence.summary: Direct searches from node2, including after both restarts, return both supplied users.

evidence.requirement: Updates require an authenticated administrator and anonymous writes fail
evidence.summary: Administrator authentication and a reversible update succeed; anonymous modification is rejected with LDAP error 8 before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Legacy operating-system release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Node1 remains Ubuntu 7.10 with kernel 2.6.22-14-generic and uses the compatible OpenLDAP 2.3.35 package.
Healthy baseline boot ID b8d1bacc… was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID f55fe8d9… observed, and LDAP listener, administrator authentication, data, and remote searches recovered.
Healthy baseline boot ID aca8fe6d… was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 691b888d… observed, and node2’s LDAP client successfully searched node1 afterward.
